operational_rules.rule: Never automate factual research without human lock
operational_rules.reason: AI hallucinations in educational or documentary videos immediately destroy channel authority.

operational_rules.rule: Always preserve thumbnail emotional instincts for human eyes
operational_rules.reason: Click-Through-Rate (CTR) is dictated by subtle emotional resonance that heuristic models often misjudge.

operational_rules.rule: Hard budget caps per video project
operational_rules.reason: Unmonitored batch image and voice generation can burn through API quotas in minutes.

operational_rules.rule: Watchdog loops on all background generation tasks
operational_rules.reason: Learned from desktop agent changelogs: agents stall and burn tokens in silent loops without timeout watchdogs.
